Let the square be centered at the origin with  
\[
A(-5,5),\ B(5,5),\ C(5,-5),\ D(-5,-5).
\]
From the figure, take \(E\) on \(AB\) and \(F\) on \(BC\). Let
\[
E=(t,5),\quad F=(5,s).
\]
Since \(OE\perp OF\),
\[
(t,5)\cdot(5,s)=5t+5s=0 \implies s=-t,
\]
so \(F=(5,-t)\).

The shaded region is quadrilateral \(OEBF\). Its area is
\[
\frac12\left|0+5t-5t+0 - (0+25+25+0)\right|
=\frac12(50)=25.
\]

\[
\boxed{25}
\]
